reason: The row is alive (SCREENED, then VERIFIED) on three gates that each pass by less than the design's own unmodelled error. The verified number itself reproduces (18.69 bit-identically, row verification), so v_gap is not in question; what is in question is whether this row should be in the loop at all. (1) Pose 203 (hub 2 c10 ring, plane 0 / elev 90 / axial 45) reads 0.158 mm at the P5-worst wall-side play against the round's 0.15 floor: +0.008 mm. The claim's own red team puts the unmodelled long-arm compliance at 0.06-0.22 mm at 203 per 0.05 N.m of K torque (row note; docs/concepts/lowarm-kstop-knuckle-3r.md 'The pinch'), i.e. 8-28x the margin. (2) Held paired vs the lead +0.4977 against the round's 0.5 kill line: 0.002 inside (row held.paired_vs_lead, docs/alignment/remeasure/lowarm-kstop-knuckle-3r_vs_conecut-knee-knuckle-3r_paired.json). Kit density was not measured on this row; the parent's shifts on the same flagged parts are -0.06 / +0.08 (row note), 30-40x the margin. (3) The stage-1 pin sits at rho 9.904 about u2, 0.036 mm inside the skirt pitch limit R_HI 9.94; at a_s 9.7 the pitch gate trips at K = 0 (dK_lim 0, fit reach 0.34; row step0.gates.bind and .md 'A cliff in the box'). (4) On held, the largest taken K is 46.268 against the J2 dowel at K-eq 46.35: 0.08 deg (row verification.held.dK_taken_max); a dowel placed 0.1 deg early cuts a held pose. (5) The bearing class was fixed to ISO P5 after P0 failed both sided gates (203 0.118 < 0.15, e- 0.408 > 0.29; row report_P0, .md 'Sided hold budget'). Each choice is disclosed and buildable, but together the pass is a stack of hairline margins, and none of them is priced in the verified number.

reason: No spring, but the dwell's +K side is held through a compliant member the model treats as rigid. The inner groove wall blocks +K (drho/dK -0.0606 mm/deg, row sidedness), and that wall load reaches the chain through the crank's 41 mm long arm, whose beam stiffness the round-15 judge estimates at 27-77 N/mm: 0.14-0.55 deg of K per 0.05 N.m of K-advancing torque, 0.06-0.22 mm at pose 203 (C10_RATE 0.40 mm/deg, model line 46). At that load 203 reads 0.10 to -0.06 mm: a contact at the soft end (.md 'The pinch': 'This is the number most likely to be optimistic'). The worn play (+0.264 / -0.210 deg) covers bearing runout, concentricity, statics and the set-screw residual only (model budget(), lines 54-63); the arm's deflection under the wearer's load is not in any wear.

reason: The fold margin passes 5 deg of th only on the law value of forced poses. Held forced poses: min th 5.006 at pose 1054; with the stage-1 groove play the claim itself states (0.23 deg) it is ~4.92, under the user's 5 deg (row verification.held.v3b_th: forced_min 5.006, note '~4.92 with 0.23 deg of groove play'). The model wears play on DWELL poses only ('Forced poses keep the law value', model docstring line 16), so the forced-pose groove play is never worn. The audit tool's fold_margin check reads 'no min-th margin on file' because the reading sits in the row's verification block, not in a verifier JSON; this finding is that reading. reason: The complexity count (16.75, against the lead's 18.5) counts parts and pairs, not the precision the design needs to work. This design's dwell hold needs an ISO P5 J2 bearing pair (P0 fails both sided gates: 203 0.118, e- 0.408 > 0.29), an M1.6 set screw set at assembly and thread-locked (a calibration step, 0.005 mm residual at r 7.5 assumed, model RES), and a stage-1 groove placed 0.036 mm inside a pitch cliff.
